actions.description: Pipette tip is positioned in/over a well of the blue tube rack; likely aspirating or dispensing, exact plunger action not visible.
Pipette is lifted and moved away from the blue rack toward the right, over the bench/white tray area.
Tip is held over/near the white tray area; no clear aspiration/dispense visible.
Pipette moves to the purple waste container; tip is positioned inside/over the container.
Pipette withdraws from the waste container with tip still attached.
Pipette returns to the blue rack with the same visible tip and is positioned in/over a well again.

reuse.evidence: The same tip is placed into/over the purple waste container and then returned to the blue rack/well without visible tip change.

surface.evidence: The tip passes near bench/tray surfaces, but visible contact with a non-sterile surface is not clear.

release.evidence: No visible unexpected tip drop/ejection; the tip remains attached after the waste-container movement.

install.evidence: Tip appears attached and seated on the pipette; no visible wrong-size or loose fit.

output.overall_summary: The clip shows the pipette using a single attached tip at the blue rack, moving to a waste container, then returning to the blue rack with the same tip. This visibly indicates tip reuse after it should have been discarded; no clear surface touch, premature release, or installation problem is visible.
